source: Earthdawn 4E Player's Guide — Legendary Status (p. 459). Mechanics only (thresholds/Renown/Reputation); definitions are original wording, no verbatim rulebook prose.
note: A character's total Legend earned (resources.legend.totalEarnt) places them in one band; the band gives how the wider world regards them — a Renown value and a Reputation bonus. Bands are matched by the first whose maxLegend the total is below (last band has maxLegend null). Labels are this app's short names for the rulebook's four bands. The `costs` block drives the Legend-spent audit (engine/legend-spent.js): attribute-increase totals, and the talent/spell rank×tier cost matrix — all mechanics only (numbers), no verbatim prose.

bands.label: Unknown
bands.definition: Beyond their master, kin, and close companions, few have heard the character's name; their deeds are unknown to the wider world.

bands.label: Recognised
bands.definition: A handful of troubadours carry tales of the character; they stand a fair chance of being known in Barsaive's larger towns, and can trade on that for better prices and the odd favour.

bands.label: Famous
bands.definition: Word of the character has spread across the province; rulers seek them out for perilous work, and admirers press free lodging and services on them.

bands.label: Legends
bands.definition: A living legend known almost everywhere; far more people claim to have met or travelled with them than could ever be true.

costs.note: attributeIncrease: Legend to raise an attribute by THAT one +1 step (per-increase, NOT cumulative — 1st=800, 2nd=1300, 3rd=2100); the total spent on an attribute is the sum of the steps taken. base+points are the free character-creation buy, only `increases` cost Legend. tiers: the Circle band that fixes a talent's cost column, set by the Circle it was learned at. talentRank[rank][tier]: Legend to raise a talent by that one rank step at that tier — cumulative sum over ranks gives a first-Discipline talent's total. A spell costs the same as a Novice talent bought to Rank = the spell's Circle (talentRank[circle].Novice). newDisciplineRank1[ordinal][lowestCircle]: Rank-1 cost of a talent in an additional Discipline (ED4 New Discipline Talent Cost Table), row = the character's lowest Discipline Circle (clamped 1..5+). equivalentTier[ordinal]: for ranks 2+ of an additional-Discipline talent, the higher effective cost tier by the talent's real Circle (ED4 Equivalent Talent Circle Table). ordinal is 2/3/4 where 4 means fourth-or-later Discipline. skillRank[rank][tier]: Legend to raise a skill by that one rank step (ED4 Skill Training Table Novice/Journeyman columns — the LEGEND cost, per Player's Guide 'Improving Skill Ranks'; the separate silver training fee is not tracked); cumulative sum over ranks gives a skill's total. Skills only reach Rank 10 and only Novice/Journeyman tiers. circleTraining[circle]: the silver training fee to advance to that Circle (ED4 Circle Training Cost Table p.454, an average cost — negotiable, so the app seeds it as an editable default; only silver is tracked, not the tutor or the 40-hour training time).
